pages.text: This chapter mentions Diamond only in ordinary prose, without a spotlight or recipe ingredient. The sample identifier is minecraft:diamond.$(br2)A careful catalog keeps its diamond beside the map, away from the wet ink and loose paper.
Diamonds are measured, wrapped, and recorded before they leave the survey camp. The word appears here as regular chapter text so prose matching can be checked separately from structured references.
When the ledger says Diamond, it means the same familiar gem. Search it in JEI and this prose-only chapter should appear beside the spotlight chapter.
